request.query: A multivariate integer polynomial with every coefficient bounded in absolute value by B has sum of absolute coefficients at most support cardinality times B

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, Finsupp.sum p b = ∑ m ∈ p.support, b m (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R

items.name: Polynomial.card_mahlerMeasure_le_prod
items.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal),
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.ncard ≤
    ∏ i, (2 * ⌊↑(n.choose ↑i) * B⌋₊ + 1)

items.name: Polynomial.card_support_mul_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, (p * q).support.card ≤ p.support.card * q.support.card

items.name: MvPolynomial.support
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)
